detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for installation of the torchtriton package from PyPI in environments using PyTorch-nightly. Flag any Python package that executes binaries on import, especially if those binaries access sensitive files (e.g., SSH keys, files in $HOME) or initiate outbound network connections. Use file integrity monitoring to detect unexpected binaries in site-packages. Network monitoring should alert on suspicious outbound connections from Python processes immediately after package installation or import.
